title: ChallengeRequest
description: What the challenger is given: the requirements, the design or both designs, where they differ, and the practices held by design.

file.description: The requirements file, relative to the project, as requirements.check named it.

requirements.description: The requirements file whole, as requirements.check accepted it.

items.description: A design, as schemas/design.json gives it.

designs.description: The design, or the first and the second written apart, in that order.

differences.description: Where the two designs differ, one line each, worked out by script; empty with one design.

practices.description: The practices held by design, from the practices files, each its id and its words.
